subject: history
concept: Applying world conflicts knowledge to a reflective real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student designs a simple remembrance or peace-themed project idea

misconception_flags: project idea shows no genuine connection to the unit's themes

interest_binding: project theme generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
